summary: The registrant, Target Hospitality Corp., filed an 8-K reporting a marketed secondary offering of 7,000,000 common shares at $17.00 per share by selling stockholders (entities controlled by TDR Capital LLP). The company will not receive any proceeds. The underwriters have a 30-day option for an additional 1,050,000 shares. The offering was made under an existing effective shelf registration statement. This is a routine secondary offering by existing shareholders, not a special situation such as a capital return or going-private transaction. The filing is a standard current report on an underwritten public offering with no special-situations characteristics.
